description: This file defines a class 'cCgroup' that manages Linux container cgroup configurations, including device permissions and resource limits, for container management within a larger system.

classes.name: cCgroup
classes.description: Represents and manages container cgroup configurations, including device permissions and resource limits.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes cCgroup with sanityCheck object and swapEnabled flag.

methods.name: devNull
methods.description: Returns configuration string for /dev/null device permission.

methods.name: devZero
methods.description: Returns configuration string for /dev/zero device permission.

methods.name: devFull
methods.description: Returns configuration string for /dev/full device permission.

methods.name: devRandom
methods.description: Returns configuration string for /dev/random device permission.

methods.name: devURandom
methods.description: Returns configuration string for /dev/urandom device permission.

methods.name: devTty
methods.description: Returns configuration string for /dev/tty device permission.

methods.name: createLxcConfDevicesCGroup
methods.description: Creates device cgroup configuration entries based on DeviceCgroup node.

methods.name: createCGroupConf
methods.description: Generates the full cgroup configuration string based on provided CGroupNode and resource limits.
